h:
简单的工作流程使用模型和 lora 加载器，使用特殊节点保存元数据，因此您需要的所有信息都保存在图像中，并且当您在 CivitAi 上上传图像时，所有内容都会被识别。

V2：

新版本包括SD1.5和sdxl Clip和Img2img。还重新组织了一下，添加了 lora 信息节点来获取触发词

还拿出了一键提示和终极sd高档。

o.en:
Simple worflow With Model and lora loader, that save the metadata with a special node so all the infos you need is save in the image and everything is recognised when you upload an image on CivitAi.

V2 :

New version include SD1.5 and sdxl clip and Img2img. Also reorganized a bit added the lora info node to get the trigger words

Also took out the one button prompt and the ultimate sd upscale.
